description: This line plot illustrates the training and validation loss curves for two experimental runs, Ex1 and Ex2, over 600,000 training steps, as part of the RedWhale project on efficient continual pretraining of a Korean LLM. The x-axis, labeled “Step,” spans from 0 to 600,000 in linear scale, with major tick marks at intervals of 100,000. The y-axis, labeled “Loss,” is displayed on a logarithmic scale ranging from 2 × 10⁰ to 1.2 × 10¹, with labeled gridlines at 2, 3, 4, 6, 10, and 11. Four distinct lines are plotted: “Ex1 Loss” (solid blue line with circular markers) begins near 3.7 at step 0, drops sharply to approximately 2.1 by step 100,000, and then gradually declines to about 1.9 by step 600,000. “Ex2 Loss” (solid cyan line with circular markers) starts near 3.2, falls to approximately 2.3 by step 100,000, and stabilizes around 2.0 after 200,000 steps. “Ex1 Validation Loss” (dashed blue line with circular markers) begins near 5.0, drops steeply to around 3.2 by step 100,000, and then slowly converges to approximately 3.1 by step 600,000. “Ex2 Validation Loss” (dashed cyan line with circular markers) starts near 11.0, drops rapidly to about 4.5 by step 50,000, then continues a slower decline to approximately 3.3 by step 600,000. All four curves exhibit a general downward trend, indicating learning progress, with training losses consistently lower than their corresponding validation losses.
